purpose: The ruler for Ask Lasso's read-set contract. Every release runs these against preview and records the manifest share and whether the expected facts appear. Expected facts are checked against the database on the day the set runs, never trusted from this file alone.

rules: Every golden board is owned by the person running the set.
Expected facts are recomputed from the database on the day of the run.
Selections are sent as the scope the dock would build; a question that needs a UI gesture (marquee, @) uses that gesture's scope_source.
